messages:
maria: Heads up — planning a coordinated publish for the py/ts SDKs tonight during the quiet window (00:30-01:30 UTC). Can folks confirm willingness to hold back pin flips for 30m if we see canary regressions?
kevin: +1 for the window. what's our rollback trigger?
jen: I'd say any 5xx rate spike across prod routes + >2% increase in token latency P50 over baseline for 15m. also watch packaging checksum mismatch alerts.
sam: agree with triggers. I'll run a dry publish on staging now and post artifacts.
maria: thanks. sam drop the staging artifacts here and I'll kick the canary via deploy-bot. plan: publish staging -> smoke -> canary cohort -> wait 30m -> full flip.
sam: staging artifacts: `s3://redwood-artifacts/publish/1767004322/staging/` — wheels + tarballs uploaded. checksums: `sha256sum *.whl` passed.
deploy-bot: deploy initiated: canary cohort = 10% traffic to py-ts-client:v2.3.0-canary. Logs: https://ci.redwood/integrations/1767004322
kevin: running quick smoke: `pip install redwood-sdk==2.3.0rc1 --index-url https://staging.pypi.redwood` — basic calls succeed, embeddings + chat calls OK.
jen: I'm watching SLO dashboard. No error spike yet. latency +0.3% P50. holding for 15m then escalate.
maria: if we hit the rollback triggers, we do immediate dist-tag pinback and roll the canary to previous release. who will execute the pinback?
sam: I can run the pinback command: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.3.0 previous && twine upload --comment 'pinback'` — will also rollback the docker sidecar.
kevin: note: if publishing fails due to signer mismatch, do NOT flip; alert infra and patch the signing key first. We had that once.
jen: adding one more thing — deprecation note for syncclient: include in release notes that sync client is deprecated in next minor, link to migration guide. We should stagger the announcement to reduce inbound support load.
maria: agreed. Release notes draft in GH gist: https://gist.github.com/maria/rel-notes-1767004322 — please add short migration blurb and changelog entries.
sam: I'm seeing a single packaging checksum warn on one wheel variant (macosx). I will re-build and re-upload in 5m.
deploy-bot: alert: canary error rate 0.6% (threshold 0.5%). Please investigate.
kevin: investigating — looks like a transient auth flake to the model registry from canary nodes. retrying.
jen: auth flake resolved, error rate back to 0.1%. No rollback needed. Marking incident as cleared. :white_check_mark:
maria: ok great. proceeding with full publish after 30m hold. once full flip completes, ops: annotate release with `deploy:full` tag and push release notes.
sam: full publish done. dist-tags updated: `npm dist-tag ls @redwood/sdk` shows `latest -> 2.3.0`. PyPI live.
deploy-bot: publish complete: rollout=100% py-ts-client:v2.3.0 at 1767004922
jen: quick post-check: latency unchanged, errors within baseline, support queue clear. sending release notes now.
maria: thanks everyone. action items: sam to follow up on the macos wheel rebuild (assigned), jen to post deprecation timeline draft, kevin to add brief postmortem for auth flake if it reoccurs. closing thread.
